title: pyrrosia obovata
intro: Pyrrosia obovata, commonly known as the Chinese Lip fern, is a type of fern native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pyrrosia obovata include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential in anti-aging and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
